sentence: This project studies how racial differences in tumor characteristics produce racial disparities in colorectal cancer survival.
This project studies how the brain controls human movement and what goes wrong in diseases such as stroke.
This project uses mass spectrometry and chemical synthesis to measure and make compounds produced by gut microbiota.
This project builds long-read sequencing methods to study how genes make different transcript isoforms in tissues and single cells.
This project studies what causes cancer and looks for biomarkers of cancer risk and prognosis in populations and cancer patients.
This project studies how social media use affects social connection and mental health in early adolescence.
This project tests whether senolytic drugs can help restore normal intraocular pressure in glaucomatous cadaver eyes.
This project brings together scientists to discuss precision genome engineering for treating genetic diseases.
This project tries to find cleaved proteins unique to cancer cells and builds tools to study their protein neighborhoods.
This project builds a lung cancer screening test that looks at the chromatin structure of cells brushed from the cheek.
This project studies how problems with mitochondria contribute to neuron death after traumatic brain injury, using cellular and animal models.
This project builds a community focused on kidney cancer immunotherapy trials and works to improve how clinical and biologic data are kept.
This project tracks toxicities and health-related quality of life in people with metastatic cancer who start immune checkpoint inhibitors.
This project tries to find out how aging changes skeletal stem cells and which molecular mechanisms control their function.
This project studies how the strongest genetic risk factor changes disease in Lewy body dementia, using human brains and mouse models.
This project uses a mouse model of mitochondrial dysfunction to find out how muscle loss happens without defects in oxidative phosphorylation.
This project studies a somatic mutation in protein kinase A in adrenal Cushing's syndrome and tests drugs that target subcellular organelles.
This project studies how the immune system responds to respiratory syncytial virus infection in hematopoietic cell transplant recipients.
This project studies the structure of influenza neuraminidase and how truncations in its stalk domain affect how it works.
This project studies how atrial microvascular and endothelial dysfunction leads to atrial fibrillation after cardiac surgery.
